title: The world map, in 3D
kaylee: Her world map is a toy board now, like Thailand's: her eight countries stand up in their real shapes with an animal on each, and Sparkle's balloon flies to the one she taps.
questions: Is this the look you wanted for the home map?
Italy, Thailand, Egypt and Peru are drawn a little bigger than life so she can see their shapes. Keep that, or true size?
Right animals? (beaver, wolf cub, camel, panda, elephant, alpaca, kangaroo, penguin, and a polar bear in the Arctic)
